title: Private Corktown and Distillery District Tour
includes: Hotel pick up and drop off (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The long time home to the Irish who fled during the Potato Famines, Corktown has had a mixed history of perseverance, struggle, success, depression, and revitalization.

Walk these historic streets and explore the neighborhood that saw more Irish immigration than Boston! Continue the tour into the Gooderham & Worts Historic Distillery District. Explore the history of the distillery, maybe try a sip of a local favorite, and see how modern movies have made it one of the most popular public spaces in Toronto today!
